name: Dangerous C Function
attack_scenario: an unbounded string/format function (gets, strcpy, sprintf, scanf) copies attacker-controlled input past a fixed buffer, corrupting the stack/heap for a classic buffer-overflow exploit
negative_test_hint: feed a 4096-byte "AAAA...AAAA" input into a 64-byte destination and assert bounded copy (truncation or rejection), never overflow

exemplar.explanation: use bounded functions (snprintf, strlcpy, fgets) with an explicit size; never gets/strcpy/sprintf on untrusted input
